description: Noise source sampled on a trigger, with the output slewing towards each new sample

params.text: Sets how slowly the output moves towards each new sample, 0 to 100%, from an instant jump to a long glide
Sets the shape of the slew, linear fully anticlockwise and exponential fully clockwise
Chooses the colour of the noise: white fully anticlockwise, pink at the centre, brown fully clockwise

inputs.text: A rising edge takes a new sample of the noise, despite the panel printing HOLD; the output then slews towards it and stays there until the next edge

outputs.text: The sampled voltage after slewing and attenuation
The raw noise on its own, -10V to 10V

notes: the OUT jack holds 0V until a rising edge arrives at HOLD; the NOISE jack carries noise from the moment the module is placed.

inputs.0: high above 0.7V · stepped · one channel only
